Cache Write became a separate billing item in September 2026 (TTL 5min $3.00, TTL 1h $6.00) and the API reports it as prompt_tokens_details.cache_write_tokens. From 00:00 Beijing time on 2026-08-23 (16:00 UTC on 2026-08-22) off-peak applies all day on Beijing-time weekends, which the pricing page states as peak 'Monday through Friday'.
